review_scope: Workflow trigger/source inspection only; no remote, dispatch, credentials or downloaded binary execution.

checks.normal_ci: ci.yml push/PR/manual: contents read; temporary branch includes macos-15-intel in test matrix alongside ARM64. No publish/deploy/push commands.
checks.windows_native: windows-native.yml explicitly admits temporary branch; native x64/ARM64 jobs remain required.
checks.release: release.yml triggered by v* tag or explicit dispatch only. Contains release/store/mirror publication and must never be dispatched/tag-triggered during integration.
checks.browser_release: browser-release.yml manual only; do not dispatch.
checks.packaging: Path-filtered branch workflow installs published package binaries and previous-version inputs. Coordinator must independently review any triggered packaging job; clean-room integrator must not execute these binaries.
checks.other_workflows: fuzz/nix/http/sdl3 triggers inspected; contents read and no publication commands found. Manual compile benchmark remains deferred.
